label: Asterisk
depicts: Six pointed asterisk with one centered vertical bar across four diagonal arms
use_when: Use when the interface wants a six arm asterisk with one full vertical stroke through the middle.
avoid_when: Do not use for the five arm starburst when the lower vertical stroke should not continue straight down.

label: Asterisk
depicts: Five pointed starburst asterisk with one top bar and four diagonal arms
use_when: Use when the interface wants the five arm starburst shape instead of a six arm asterisk.
avoid_when: Do not use for the six arm asterisk when a full vertical center stroke should be visible.

label: Base Station
depicts: Antenna mast on a short stand with left and right radio wave arc marks
use_when: Use when the interface wants a vertical antenna mast on a short stand with side signal waves.
avoid_when: Do not use for the A shaped signal tower when the center stem should not form a letter A.

label: Base Station
depicts: A letter A antenna shape with left and right radio wave arc marks
use_when: Use when the interface wants a broadcast tower shaped like a letter A with signal arcs on both sides.
avoid_when: Do not use for the simple mast on a stand when the center support should stay vertical.

label: Baseball
depicts: Baseball circle with two stitched seams curving toward a centered middle
use_when: Use when the interface wants a baseball ball with curved seams inside a round outline.
avoid_when: Do not use for the bat and ball icon when the stick shape should be visible too.
